task_completion.description: The abdominal CT volume amos_0001.nii.gz is loaded into 3D Slicer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer interface shows the CT scan in the axial, sagittal, and coronal views. The filename 'amos_0001' is visible in the Data module or volume selector.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the axial slice showing the maximum aortic diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The axial slice slider or slice information indicates slice index 45 (or the slice where the aorta appears largest).

task_completion.description: A 'Closed Curve' markup is initiated and drawn around the aorta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A green or colored closed loop with control points is visible encircling the aorta in the axial view. The Markups module shows a 'ClosedCurve' node.

task_completion.description: The closed curve uses at least 6 control points to define the aortic boundary.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least 6 distinct control point markers (spheres or dots) are visible on the curve in the axial slice or listed in the Markups control point table.

task_completion.description: The cross-sectional area is calculated/displayed by the software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Markups module or a measurement overlay shows an area value (expected near 855 mm²).

task_completion.description: The results are saved to the specified JSON file path with all required fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the content of 'aortic_area_measurement.json' containing patient_id, measurement_type, slice_index, cross_sectional_area_mm2, num_control_points, and curve_name.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to perform the measurement rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Markups tool and placing points manually on the CT image.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected area into a file without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement value in the JSON matches the value dynamically generated in the Slicer Markups UI.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual amos_0001.nii.gz file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The image background and anatomy in the slices match a standard abdominal CT scan, not a placeholder image.
